Scenarios

Source

PNG images, 1 pixel = 1 tile, native size, read as raw samples. Select several at once (height, zones, edges…); a pack .json (evodun-pack/0.2) can go with them.

Channel roles

Slice

Zones: click = only this zone · Ctrl/Shift-click = add or remove
Rooms (rooms on): click = only this room · Ctrl/Shift-click = add or remove
Crop in tiles (x1, y1 exclusive; blank = no limit)

Floors

Stack and cutaway: orthographic cameras only (Cam 1-5, 7); stake and objectives are placed in the single-floor views. The cutaway plane follows the camera yaw (the cut is recomputed when a drag is released).

Macroform

Baked parameters (read-only)
Changing them needs tools/derive_snake_macroform.py: the page cannot produce or tune the volume.

   
The volume is drawn with 1 tile of height = 1 tile of width (V = 2 tiles per elevation unit, provisional); Off draws the quantized terraces, so the two have different vertical scales. Cam 1-5 only.

  

  
Incursion

   

   
Pick a mode, then click the map (Esc cancels). The route runs from each objective to the stake over the walkable tiles, ramps included.

   

  

  

  

  
Display

  
Drag: small angle variation · Shift/right-drag: pan · wheel: zoom · double-click: reset
